operation: APK-first complete original 398-entry primary weapon high-loader/atlas order and metadata, all real placeholder texture bytes/mips/native properties and all 398 original material bindings. Original source manager shader/default material config retains all actual fallback dependencies. Reuse byte-hash-verified existing programs; translate missing original GLES3 programs only after selecting their actual graphics API/GPU tables, preserve original empty stripped passes and shader LOD/keyword scope, and retain raw source programs. Reuse the two prior actual high pages and default placeholders without changing their identity. Empty dye proxy objects retain empty original GUIDs. Explicit local catalog owns packaged assets; independent request release drops only the request reference. No SDK implementation or substitute prefab is used.
validated_scope: Unity 2022.3.57f1c2 Direct3D Play Mode: all 398 original placeholder/main/dye GUID rows and ordered native atlas material identities, source high-loader and manager config, 399 original materials and 12,349 exact serialized float/color values; 400 actual native GPU mip hashes (4,563,564 bytes), including all placeholders and original IceNoise/IceTexture; 22 new Windows D3D stages across full shader fallback chain. Real local loader/GUID request ownership, original AppearanceUILite two-owner lifetime, source empty dye-proxy/null-result branch, indexed atlas restoration and original real-atlas shared material clone return pass; two real weapon GPU captures viewed. Graphic endpoint and low-memory subscription are fixtures; production original weapon prefab/page remains unbound.
limitations: Only the two actual default sword/staff high pages are bound. Other original high-page GUIDs remain intact and requests fail explicitly until their payloads are converted.
Production native Graphic, full weapon prefab/parts and profession-page input/save/Windows release remain incomplete.
